mapper.sql: p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.tags, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.favorite_count, p.comment_count, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.nickname AS author_nickname, ua.file_path AS author_avatar
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lantu_web_dsn.posts p LEFT JOIN lantu_web.users u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN lantu_web.user_avatars ua ON p.user_id = ua.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 1

SELECT FROM lantu_web_dsn.posts p LEFT JOIN lantu_web.users u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN lantu_web.user_avatars ua ON p.user_id = ua.user_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT FROM lantu_web_dsn.post_favorites f INNER JOIN lantu_web_dsn.posts p ON f.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN lantu_web.users u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN lantu_web.user_avatars ua ON p.user_id = ua.user_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT FROM lantu_web_dsn.posts p LEFT JOIN lantu_web.users u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN lantu_web.user_avatars ua ON p.user_id = ua.user_id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY (p.view_count + p.like_count * 5 + p.favorite_count * 10 + p.comment_count * 8) DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
